column1: # D-161 mutation-pass results — Group 2 oracle-gap fixes (batch 1 of 11)
Group 2 = the 11 "unexercised branch" survivors from the 2b-ext sweep. Each fix is a
FUNCTIONAL fixture that drives the specific branch (not a source-text pin). This batch
covers items #10, #2, #3, #4, #9, #1, #5, #6, #7, #8 + Group 3 + INV-4 proof — verified across eight isolated exact-HEAD passes:
- pass A (source `695e13e`): item #10 — 1 mutant, 1 killed
- pass B (source `1e759f3`): items #2, #3, #4 — 3 mutants, 3 killed
- pass C (source `f47e2de`): item #9 — 1 mutant, 1 killed
- pass D (source `a0cb2f7`): item #1 + the mislabeled #5 approval-hash — 2 mutants, 2 killed
- pass E (source `e102e14`): items #3, #6, #7, #8 — 4 mutants, 4 killed
- pass F (source `3095f2`): bootstrap #3b identity-preflight bonus row — 1 mutant, 1 killed
- pass G (source `6a3f771`): item #5 real (unsafe-retired-path glob) — 1 mutant, 1 killed
- pass H (source `90f1d20`): Group 3 status.sh podman-condition + teardown.sh stop-vs-start — 2 mutants, 2 killed
- proof pass I (source `90f1d20`): check-test-surface.py authored mutants (import allowlist inverted; route match inverted) — both KILLED by the existing fixture suite; no new tests needed
- suite: `python3 -m pytest scripts/selftest/selftest_*.py -q`
- totals: 17 mutants; 17 killed; 0 survived; 0 authoring errors
- enforcement: report-only; survivors are evidence for oracle improvement, never a build gate
| verdict | file | mutation | reason |

| KILLED | `scripts/tpm-agent.sh` | `exec claude --settings scripts/tpm-agent-settings.json` → `exec claude --settings scripts/tpm-agent-settings-missing.json` | Group2 #10 default-mode settings file (fake `claude` on PATH records argv; asserts the repo settings filename, not `-missing`) |

| KILLED | `scripts/check-drift.sh` | `if [ "$child" = "$head_h" ]; then` → `if [ "$child" != "$head_h" ]; then` | Group2 #2 IN_SYNC (real (child,clone) pair with identical bytes → exit 0, "in sync"; mutant misreads the in-sync file as BEHIND → exit 2) |

| KILLED | `scripts/sandbox-run.sh` | `scripts\|scripts/*\|.git\|...` → `scripts\|scripts/*` | Group2 #3 dotgit blocklist (`--rw .git` refused by the control-plane blocklist before podman; mutant dropped .git/.githooks from the list) |

| KILLED | `scripts/sandbox-run.sh` | `"$repo_canon"/*) ;;` → `"$repo_canon") ;;` | Group2 #4 valid subdir allow (`--rw src` is allowed, not "escapes repo root"; mutant narrowed the pattern to an exact repo-root match) |

| KILLED | `scripts/tpm-agent.sh` | `if [ "$MODE" = view ]; then` → `if [ "$MODE" != view ]; then` | Group2 #9 view-mode settings file (`--view` with a stubbed tpm-view.sh + fake `claude` on PATH records argv; asserts the VIEW settings path, not the default) |

| KILLED | `scripts/new-project.sh` | `THINKING_MODEL) die "..." ;;` → `THINKING_MODEL) echo "  ok: local LLM responded" ;;` | Group2 #1 thinking-model pre-flight (PATH-stubbed `curl` serves a reasoning-only reply; asserts the Hard Rule 1 halt message and that no "ok: local LLM responded" appears) |

| KILLED | `scripts/link-template.sh` | `[ "$APPROVE" = "$PLAN_SHA" ] || die ...` → `[ "$APPROVE" != "$PLAN_SHA" ] || die ...` | Group2 #5 approval-hash gate both directions (wrong hash dies "approval hash mismatch" applying nothing; correct hash from the preview applies; mutant accepts wrong/rejects correct) |

| KILLED | `scripts/bootstrap.sh` | `git config --global --add safe.directory "$root"` → `... "$root-never"` | Group2 #3 dubious-ownership trust (stubbed `git` refuses once then only accepts the EXACT canonical path; asserts rc 0, the trust message, and the logged exact `safe.directory $root` line; `$root-never` leaves the checkout refused) |

| KILLED | `scripts/llm-call.sh` | `if not content and reasoning:` → `if content and reasoning:` | Group2 #6 reasoning-only halt (real local HTTP endpoint serves a reasoning-only reply → "reasoning but no content"/Hard Rule 1 die; content+reasoning reply accepted; mutant swaps which reply dies) |

| KILLED | `scripts/llm-call.sh` | `elif served != expect_model:` → `elif served == expect_model:` | Group2 #7 seat mismatch (`--expect-model` with served≠expected dies "seat mismatch", served==expected applies; mutant inverts both directions) |

| KILLED | `scripts/update-template.sh` | `[ "$APPROVE" = "$DIFF_SHA" ] || die` → `[ "$APPROVE" != "$DIFF_SHA" ] || die` | Group2 #8 approval-hash gate both directions (wrong DIFF-SHA dies applying nothing; the previewed DIFF-SHA applies for real with a `[template-update]` commit; mutant accepts wrong/rejects correct) |

| KILLED | `scripts/bootstrap.sh` | `if [ -z "$(git config user.name \|\| true)" ] \` → `if [ -n ... ] \` | Group2 #3b identity preflight (same fixture runs the happy path WITH identity set and must proceed; the inverted check dies on a configured environment) — bonus row: this survivor was also driven by the #3 fixture |

| KILLED | `scripts/link-template.sh` | `case "$path" in ""\|/*\|../*\|*/../*\|*/..\|..) die ...` → narrowed to `""\|/*` | Group2 #5 real: unsafe-retired-path glob (child manifest carries a `../outside.sh` row; adoption must die "unsafe retired path" before any rm; mutant deletes through the traversal and dies later at git add) |

| KILLED | `scripts/status.sh` | `if [ "${STATUS:-}" = "Running" ]; then` → `!=` | Group3 podman section keyed to VM state (stubbed limactl serves Running then Stopped: Running shows "stopped (reclaimable)" and no skip note, Stopped the reverse; mutant flips both directions) |

| KILLED | `scripts/teardown.sh` | `do_or_say "limactl stop dev-vm"` → `"limactl start dev-vm"` | Group3 stop-vs-start observable (`--lima` against a Running stub-VM; the argv log must contain exactly `limactl stop dev-vm`, never start) |

| KILLED | `scripts/check-test-surface.py` | `if mod not in modules:` → `if mod in modules:` | INV-4 mutation proof 1/2: import allowlist inverted — killed by the existing clean+violating fixture tests, no new test needed |

| KILLED | `scripts/check-test-surface.py` | `if not any(path_matches(path, t) for t in templates):` → `if any(...)` | INV-4 mutation proof 2/2: route-match inverted — killed by the existing clean+violating fixture tests, no new test needed |
